hero.tagline: I build things that run in production: agentic pipelines, generative AI systems, and full-stack web apps. Python and TypeScript, from training loops to deployed products with real users.

about.bio_1: AI and fullstack engineer who ships things to production. I work across the full stack: from training loops and agentic pipelines to React frontends and containerized APIs. I care that real users can depend on what I build.
about.bio_2: Python and TypeScript are my primary languages. My work spans generative AI (StyleGAN2, CLIP, SDXL), multi-agent orchestration (LangGraph, RAG, LLM-as-judge), and production web services (FastAPI, Next.js, Docker). Based in Tunisia.
about.cta_body: Whether it's a project, a role, or just a conversation worth having.

bullets: Managing a small cross-functional team across three concurrent projects: coordinating milestones, unblocking technical decisions, and keeping delivery on track.
Contributing to architecture and system design across projects, shaping technical direction alongside engineering.
Built the company website from scratch with Next.js.

Built a KYC automation system from scratch: integrated Didit's identity verification API via a webhook handler and status-driven state machine. Live in production with tens of thousands of users, zero downtime since launch.
Led a full analytics migration across a 4-app Next.js monorepo: replaced PostHog with Amplitude via a custom Node.js server-side proxy, preventing client-side tracking gaps across all applications.

Maintained and improved 4 live applications in parallel, resolving production bugs under live conditions and adding lazy loading, Suspense partial rendering, WebM video conversion, and mobile optimizations.
Built a full fleet management platform (web + mobile): real-time vehicle tracking, OpenStreetMap routing, QR code workflow automation, and an operations dashboard, delivered to a live client.
